jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist (Lending)
sections: Quyền lợi
Be part of one of Southeast Asia’s most ambitious superapps — a homegrown tech company solving real-world challenges across transportation, food delivery, logistics, fintech, maps, and more.
We operate with millions of transactions per day, and we’re now investing heavily in cutting-edge data science to drive our next phase of growth.

You’ll build models and decisioning systems that shape customer onboarding, credit access, and portfolio health—serving millions of transactions and users across multiple domains (fintech and beyond).
What You’ll Do You’ll lead the technical data science workstream for online lending products, owning end-to-end delivery from problem framing to production impact: Credit risk & scoring: Build,…
Propensity & onboarding intelligence: Develop propensity models across the funnel (conversion, activation, repeat borrowing, churn) and optimize onboarding flows.
Full lifecycle ownership: Translate business goals and risk constraints into clear technical problems; drive experimentation, deployment, performance tracking, and iterative improvement.
Data & production readiness: Own the technical side of data processing for lending use-cases—feature definitions, data quality checks, pipeline requirements, reproducible training, model monitoring,…
Collaborative impact: Partner with Product, Risk, Engineering, Operations, and Leadership to embed models into core lending workflows and ensure adoption.

jobs.title: Junior Data Scientist - Meta Performance
sections: Mô tả công việc
Crossian is a high-growth technology-driven e-commerce business.
Behind our success is our people.
As a start-up formed in 2020, we have created a fast-paced and dynamic environment, enabling our people to reach a cumulative average growth rate of over 1000% in just under 3 years.
Our mission now is to build direct-to-consumer brands and increase customer lifetime value.
Our Meta Performance team runs on an in-house, AI-driven advertising automation platform.
As a Junior Data Scientist, you improve the data, parameters and rules that feed those decisions, and prove every change with backtests and experiments before it runs on real ad spend.
You work on production data from thousands of campaigns, and the impact of your work shows up directly in revenue and profit.
Analyze and improve the inputs that feed the platform's AI models and decision rules (e.g. conversion, ROAS and spend signals), so the automation engine makes better decisions.

Education: Bachelor's degree in Mathematics & Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science or Data Science, from a technical university (e.g.

Experience: Fresh graduates with at least 6 months of experience (internships count) in data science, ML or data analytics. Strong ML projects, a research thesis or Kaggle results are a plus.
Machine Learning: Understanding of supervised learning (regression, tree-based models such as XGBoost/LightGBM), feature engineering and model evaluation.
Programming: Python (pandas, NumPy) and SQL for data analysis.
Nice to have: Time-series forecasting, optimization (LP/MIP), causal inference, or experience with ad-tech or e-commerce data.

jobs.title: Data Governance Engineer
sections: Mô tả công việc
MoMo's Data Platform manages petabytes of data and thousands of pipelines.
They serve product analytics, business reporting, and machine learning for fraud detection, credit scoring, and personalization.
Every one of these uses depends on three conditions: the right people can reach the right data, the data can be trusted, and its use complies with the law;
We are moving from a BigQuery-centric stack to a hybrid lakehouse across cloud and on-premise, for better data control, lower cost, and compliance with Vietnam's personal data protection regulations.
This shift makes governance harder.
Access policies must hold across several engines and environments.
Data quality must be verified on both sides of a migration.
Regulations that change every few months must become controls that engineers, analysts, and business teams can actually use.
Yêu cầu
3+ years building and running production web applications, on both the backend and the frontend;
Strong backend skills in at least one language such as Go, Java, or Python, including API design and relational databases such as PostgreSQL;
Hands-on frontend experience with a modern framework such as React and TypeScript, building data-heavy interfaces: tables, forms, and multi-step workflows;
Solid SQL and a working understanding of how warehouses and lakehouses organize data: schemas, tables, partitions, and lineage;
Experience implementing authentication and authorization, such as SSO with OAuth or OIDC, role-based or attribute-based access control, and audit logging.
Experience deploying services on containers and Kubernetes with CI/CD;
You can take a loosely defined requirement from a non-technical stakeholder, such as a new legal rule, and turn it into a working feature with clear scope;
You can read an unfamiliar codebase, find why a feature is slow or wrong, and fix it;

Cennext là sự kết hợp của đội ngũ nhân viên trẻ, năng động, nhiệt tình, các giải pháp và công nghệ cao nhằm đảm bảo cung cấp cho khách hàng những giải pháp tối ưu.
Mô tả công việc
Chịu trách nhiệm khai thác dữ liệu từ hệ thống Odoo và xây dựng hệ thống báo cáo, dashboard trên Tableau, giúp Ban lãnh đạo và các phòng ban theo dõi KPI và ra quyết định dựa trên số liệu chính xác,…
Đồng thời làm việc với các phòng ban để thống nhất định nghĩa chỉ số, đảm bảo số liệu nhất quán và dễ sử dụng.
1. Khai thác & chuẩn bị dữ liệu
Kết nối và khai thác dữ liệu từ hệ thống Odoo (cơ sở dữ liệu PostgreSQL) phục vụ báo cáo.
Viết truy vấn SQL, làm sạch, chuẩn hóa và mô hình hóa dữ liệu (bán hàng, mua hàng, tồn kho, công nợ…) thành nguồn dữ liệu ổn định cho báo cáo.
Kiểm tra, đối chiếu số liệu trên báo cáo với số liệu thực tế để đảm bảo độ chính xác.
2. Xây dựng dashboard & báo cáo trên Tableau
Thiết kế và xây dựng dashboard, báo cáo trên Tableau theo dõi KPI kinh doanh và vận hành.
Yêu cầu
Tốt nghiệp Đại học/Cao đẳng chuyên ngành Hệ thống Thông tin, Khoa học Dữ liệu, Thống kê, Kinh tế, Quản trị Kinh doanh hoặc các ngành tương đương.
Tối thiểu 1 năm kinh nghiệm ở vị trí Data Analyst / BI Analyst / Reporting, trong đó trực tiếp xây dựng dashboard trên Tableau.
Thành thạo Tableau: tự xây dựng dashboard hoàn chỉnh; sử dụng tốt calculated fields, LOD expressions, table calculations, parameters, actions; hiểu và sử dụng phù hợp extract và live connection.
Viết SQL tốt: join nhiều bảng, aggregate, window functions; có khả năng làm việc với cơ sở dữ liệu PostgreSQL.
Có tư duy về số liệu kinh doanh (doanh thu, công nợ, tồn kho, hiệu suất…) và khả năng phát hiện số liệu bất thường.
Thành thạo Excel / Google Sheets.
Kỹ năng giao tiếp tốt, trình bày số liệu rõ ràng, dễ hiểu cho người không chuyên.
Tiếng Anh đọc hiểu tài liệu kỹ thuật.

Job Overview:
The Data Engineer is responsible for building, maintaining, and optimizing data pipelines and data models that support both analytics and AI/ML workloads.
The role works closely with Software Engineers, Data Analytics, and AI team to ensure data is reliable, well-documented, and ready for consumption.
Mô tả công việc
Design, build, and maintain automated ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest data from multiple sources.
Develop and maintain robust data models for analytics and reporting.
Implement scheduling, monitoring, and alerting to ensure pipeline reliability and SLA compliance.
Build and maintain metadata documentation (table & column descriptions) and contribute to the semantic layer (dataset purposes, field definitions, business logic, and relationships).
Prepare and maintain datasets for AI/ML use cases, including training datasets and feature pipelines (under guidance of senior members/AI team).
Collaborate with the AI team to understand data requirements for model training, evaluation, and monitoring.
Support the development of data serving layers/APIs that enable AI systems to consume data.
Implement data quality checks, validation rules, and basic governance practices.

Minimum 2–3 years of experience as a Data Engineer (experience in AI/ML-related data environments is a strong plus).
Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
Solid understanding of relational databases, data modeling, and data warehousing concepts.
Experience with dbt, or with building modular, tested, version-controlled SQL transformations using comparable tools (e.g. SQLMesh, Dataform, or Spark SQL orchestrated by Airflow).
Experience building and operating ETL/ELT pipelines in production environments.
Familiarity with workflow orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect.
Experience working with cloud infrastructure.
Understanding of Linux-based environments and cloud infrastructure components relevant to data workloads, such as virtual machines, storage, databases, and networking

jobs.title: Senior - Data Governance Engineer
sections: Mô tả công việc
MoMo's Data Platform manages petabytes of data and thousands of pipelines.
They serve product analytics, business reporting, and machine learning for fraud detection, credit scoring, and personalization.
Every one of these uses depends on three conditions: the right people can reach the right data, the data can be trusted, and its use complies with the law;
We are moving from a BigQuery-centric stack to a hybrid lakehouse across cloud and on-premise, for better data control, lower cost, and compliance with Vietnam's personal data protection regulations.
This shift makes governance harder.
Access policies must hold across several engines and environments.
Data quality must be verified on both sides of a migration.
Regulations that change every few months must become controls that engineers, analysts, and business teams can actually use.
Yêu cầu
3+ years building and running production web applications, on both the backend and the frontend;
Strong backend skills in at least one language such as Go, Java, or Python, including API design and relational databases such as PostgreSQL;
Hands-on frontend experience with a modern framework such as React and TypeScript, building data-heavy interfaces: tables, forms, and multi-step workflows;
Solid SQL and a working understanding of how warehouses and lakehouses organize data: schemas, tables, partitions, and lineage;
Experience implementing authentication and authorization, such as SSO with OAuth or OIDC, role-based or attribute-based access control, and audit logging.
Experience deploying services on containers and Kubernetes with CI/CD;
You can take a loosely defined requirement from a non-technical stakeholder, such as a new legal rule, and turn it into a working feature with clear scope;
You can read an unfamiliar codebase, find why a feature is slow or wrong, and fix it;

Mô tả công việc
Thiết kế và xây dựng nền tảng dữ liệu trên Microsoft Fabric: OneLake, kiến trúc lakehouse và warehouse, các pipeline và dataflow trong Fabric Data Factory, notebook, và các mô hình ngữ nghĩa…
Dẫn dắt quá trình di dời từ Azure Data Factory và Azure SQL sang Fabric: Đánh giá các workload, lên lộ trình di dời, duy trì các công việc ADF mới luôn sẵn sàng cho Fabric, và chạy thử nghiệm (PoC)…
Làm chủ kiến trúc Medallion từ đầu đến cuối: Tầng ingest bronze, tầng chuẩn hóa silver, và tầng gold của các bảng fact và dimension, bao gồm cả các view thống nhất giữa hệ thống CRM và sản phẩm hiện…
Thiết lập và thực thi các tiêu chuẩn kỹ thuật: Xử lý lỗi, cơ chế thử lại (retries), giám sát và cảnh báo, thông báo lỗi, quy tắc đặt tên, code review, kiểm thử đơn vị và kiểm tra chất lượng dữ liệu.
Vận hành hệ thống do chính bạn xây dựng: Đảm bảo độ tin cậy của pipeline, xử lý sự cố gốc, và giao tiếp rõ ràng trong quá trình thực hiện.
Cố vấn cho kỹ sư dữ liệu junior: Hướng dẫn thông qua đánh giá thiết kế, lập trình cặp (pairing) và code review.
Làm việc trực tiếp với ban lãnh đạo dữ liệu tại Mỹ về các ưu tiên, lộ trình, đánh đổi và trình bày tiến độ trong các cuộc họp đánh giá hàng tháng với lãnh đạo LTS.
Đưa quản trị dữ liệu (Data Governance) vào Fabric khi nền tảng di dời: danh mục dữ liệu, phân loại và lineage bằng các công cụ native của Fabric.
Yêu cầu
Kinh nghiệm: Trên 6 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực kỹ thuật dữ liệu (data engineering), với ít nhất 3 năm làm chủ kiến trúc nền tảng dữ liệu production trên Azure.
Kinh nghiệm thực tế với Microsoft Fabric: Lakehouse và warehouse trên OneLake, pipeline/dataflow Fabric Data Factory, notebook (PySpark hoặc Spark SQL), và mô hình ngữ nghĩa cho Power BI.
Đã hoàn thành một dự án di dời sang Fabric là lợi thế lớn.
Kinh nghiệm sâu rộng về Azure Data Factory và Azure SQL: Đã xây dựng và vận hành pipeline ADF ở quy mô lớn và am hiểu các điểm yếu/lỗi thường gặp.
Kỹ năng chuyên sâu về SQL và mô hình hóa chiều (dimensional
modeling): Thiết kế bảng fact, dimension và tầng chuẩn hóa bên dưới.
Python cho data engineering: PySpark, pandas, testing, packaging.
Kỷ luật vận hành trong production: Xử lý lỗi, cơ chế thử lại, tải idempotent, giám sát và cảnh báo, kiểm tra chất lượng dữ liệu, CI/CD cho pipeline với Git và Azure DevOps.

Mức lương: Lên tới 65M Gross.

○ Thời gian làm việc linh hoạt.

jobs.title: Middle/Senior Data Orchestration - Data Engineer
sections: Mô tả công việc
MoMo's data platform processes petabytes of data through thousands of pipelines every day.
It powers product analytics, business performance analysis, insight validation, and machine learning models for fraud detection, credit scoring, and personalization.
Its reliability directly affects business decisions and product performance;
We are moving from a platform built primarily on BigQuery toward a hybrid lakehouse across cloud and on-premises infrastructure.
The shift addresses growing demands for data control, lower cost, and regulatory compliance.
It also introduces harder operational problems: distributed compute, constrained capacity, platform migration, and the separation of workloads by data sensitivity;
The Data Orchestration team owns data ingestion, movement between environments, and modeling for downstream users.
You will build and operate pipelines and models as the platform moves to the lakehouse, keeping existing reports and data products dependable.
Yêu cầu
2+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, or a related backend or infrastructure role, with production systems you built or ran;
Strong SQL and hands-on experience with at least one of Python, Java, or Scala;
Hands-on experience with at least one distributed data technology such as Apache Spark, Apache Flink, Kafka, BigQuery, or an MPP engine;
Experience building and running scheduled or streaming pipelines in production, with Airflow or a similar orchestrator;
A solid grasp of data fundamentals: data modeling, partitioning, incremental loads, and why a pipeline can produce a wrong result;
Git, code review, and CI/CD as normal practice.
Experience with dbt or data quality and testing frameworks;
Experience with open table formats such as Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi;

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer
sections: Giới thiệu
At Paystone, we build technology that helps businesses strengthen customer relationships and drive sustainable growth.
Our integrated suite of payment and software solutions brings together payment processing, loyalty, gift cards and reputation marketing, supporting thousands of merchants across North America.
As part of Paystone’s suite of products, DataCandy powers gift card and loyalty programmes for thousands of merchants.
Mô tả công việc
This is a hands-on, build role, where you will help establish and own DataCandy’s customer data foundation.
You will centralise product, client, commercial and lifecycle data in Databricks, develop consistent business metrics, and surface meaningful insights through Salesforce to help teams identify…
What You’ll Do
Build and maintain reliable data pipelines and models across Salesforce, transaction, product, onboarding, renewal, pricing and support data
Develop and maintain a governed Client 360 view connecting accounts, locations, products, commercial terms, adoption and revenue performance
Define and document trusted metrics for GRR, NRR, churn, client health, time-to-value and renewal risk
Develop automated client health scoring and renewal-risk triggers across the customer portfolio
Surface clear, actionable client insights in Salesforce to support Customer Success and Account Management teams
Yêu cầu
Experience with any of the following would be an advantage:
Salesforce data models
SaaS retention and customer health metrics
dbt
Payments, loyalty or B2B SaaS environments
Quyền lợi
This role gives you the opportunity to help build a data foundation from the ground up and directly influence how the business uses data to manage and support its clients.
You will have the opportunity to design scalable solutions, automate manual processes and create data products that directly support business decision-making.
If you are excited by the opportunity to build, automate and create rather than simply maintain, we would like to hear from you.
Compensation tied to market data
We reward for contribution
Flexible Time-off
We’re committed to career development
Work from home

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.company: Axon Active - Agile Software Development Company
sections: Mô tả công việc
Work as a member of an international product team to design, build, and maintain data pipelines and data marts for an inhouse Snowflake data warehouse
Analyse internally and externally sourced raw data to generate BI and Advanced Analytics datasets based on stakeholders' requirements
Design and execute data migration from existing databases (PostgreSQL, MS SQL) to the inhouse data warehouse
Continuously enhance data quality and reliability, and champion data engineering best practices within the team
Collaborate daily with the foreign Product Owner within a cross-functional Scrum team
Join onsite business trips if required
Yêu cầu
5 years of experience in data engineering or a similar role, preferably in the financial industry
Deep, hands-on knowledge of Snowflake, including data modeling, performance tuning, and cost optimization (SnowPro Core certification is a plus)
Strong understanding of ETL, data warehouse, and data modeling concepts: data marts, star schema, dimensional modeling
Proven experience designing and building data pipelines to curate raw data into an enterprise data warehouse
Hands-on experience with data migration from relational databases (PostgreSQL, MS SQL) to a cloud data warehouse, including data validation
Strong programming skills with advanced knowledge of Python and/or Java for building production-grade data pipelines
Experience with AWS cloud technologies such as RDS and Fargate (AWS Data Engineer / Solutions Architect certification or AWS Glue experience is a plus)
Understanding of BI (e.g. Qlik) and Advanced Data Analytics concepts
Quyền lợi
Free lunch at the office
Competitive salary & 13th salary
Fully compulsory insurances
Annual premium healthcare and 24/24 personal accident insurance
Additional healthcare insurance for family members
Annual health check-ups
Working from home option, one day per week
Flexible working hours; up to 18 days off per year

jobs.title: Quantitative Researcher
sections: Mô tả công việc
PI ASSOCIATES JSC.
is offering internship positions for highly motivated individuals who aspire to become talented quantitative researchers and join our team of finance professionals.
The ideal candidate will have a passion for using data and mathematical models to make informed investment decisions and drive alpha generation in the stock market.
Role Overview
We need researchers with a strong mathematical foundation and abstract thinking to design and build agentic research workflows, and to use them to develop and validate trading signals.
Design and build agentic research workflows (planning, tool use, memory, evaluation loops) that automate parts of the research cycle.
Develop autonomous or semi-autonomous agents that run experiments, validate ideas, and iterate on research outputs.
Integrate LLM-based agents into the quant research pipeline to automate repetitive modeling tasks.
Yêu cầu
Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, statistics, computer science, finance, or a related field.
Solid grounding in probability, statistics, linear algebra, and optimization.
Ability to break a vague problem into clear components, formalize it, and translate it into executable logic and agent behavior.
Python programming skills, with experience in quantitative logic or time-series analysis.
Experience with, or strong interest in, LLM agents, agentic workflows, AI-driven automation, or research agents.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good communication skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced research environment.
WHY YOU WILL LOVE WORKING HERE

flexible work hours
vacation and leaves
medical coverage
team building events
travel
work station
professional development
career growth

jobs.title: Data Science Expert
sections: Mô tả công việc
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to build Forecasting, Decision Intelligence, Optimization, and AI capabilities for Finance.
You will connect predictive insights with business decisions, optimize resource allocation, and deliver measurable financial impact.
What You’ll Do
Build forecasting and decision intelligence solutions across key banking businesses, such as CASA, Deposits, Lending, and Credit Cards.
Develop driver-based forecasting and scenario analysis frameworks to improve financial planning, budgeting, and business performance.
Connect forecasts and their uncertainty with optimization and business rules to support better planning and resource allocation decisions.
Apply marketing mix modeling, causal inference, experimentation, and uplift modeling to measure incremental business impact and optimize investment allocation.
Automate data processing, analysis, insight generation, and decision-support workflows.
Quyền lợi
Competitive salary package, including 13th-month salary and performance-based bonus.
Annual salary review and performance evaluation.
15 days of annual leave and 01 birthday leave.
Opportunities to participate in Techcombank's advanced training and development programs.
Clear career development pathways with strong support and guidance from the management team.

Comprehensive employee well-being benefits, including health insurance/healthcare coverage, annual health check-ups, birthday gifts from the Bank, team-building activities, year-end parties, and more.
Provision of all necessary tools and equipment to support work effectively.
Access to professional and technical training programs to enhance job-related competencies.

ST Engineering is a leading global technology, defense, and engineering conglomerate headquartered in Singapore.

Build and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports, and help business users get answers without always coming back to the analytics team.

Strong SQL and solid Python for analysis and automation.
A good grasp of data warehousing, dimensional modelling, and ELT/ETL.

sections: Giới thiệu
Các trách nhiệm chính
Chịu trách nhiệm phát triển, thực thi các giải pháp Phân tích Dữ liệu Kiểm toán (ADA), tự động hóa kịch bản kiểm tra và ứng dụng AI/Machine Learning nhằm chuyển đổi phương pháp kiểm toán từ chọn mẫu…

Vị trí này đóng vai trò cầu nối dữ liệu kỹ thuật với nghiệp vụ kiểm toán, đồng thời phải am hiểu về kiểm toán CNTT (IT Audit) để thẩm định độ tin cậy của dữ liệu đầu vào và làm chủ các yêu cầu Bảo vệ…
Mô tả công việc
Thực hiện Phân tích Dữ liệu Kiểm toán (ADA Execution) & Xử lý Big Data:
Lập trình các kịch bản truy vấn (SQL, Python, Alteryx) để rà soát toàn bộ tổng thể giao dịch, phát hiện các điểm bất thường (Anomalies), vi phạm chốt kiểm soát và dấu hiệu gian lận.
Xây dựng các kịch bản kiểm tra dữ liệu tự động cho các mục tiêu kiểm toán tại các quy trình nghiệp vụ có độ ổn định luồng xử lý (Tài chính, Tín dụng, Thanh toán, Mua bán ngoại tệ...).
Thực hiện các cấp độ phân tích từ Mô tả (Descriptive), Chẩn đoán (Diagnostic) đến Dự báo (Predictive) trên các tập dữ liệu từ các hệ thống dữ liệu.
Thẩm định Độ tin cậy & Chất lượng Dữ liệu:
Đánh giá tính đầy đủ (Completeness), tính chính xác (Accuracy) và tính nhất quán của Thông tin do ngân hàng tạo ra (IPE - Information Produced by the Entity) trước khi đưa vào phân tích.
Đánh giá mối liên hệ giữa chất lượng dữ liệu với hiệu lực của các Chốt kiểm soát chung CNTT (ITGCs) và Kiểm soát ứng dụng (Application Controls) trên hệ thống nguồn.
Rà soát nguồn gốc dữ liệu (Data Lineage) và quy trình trích xuất ETL để xác nhận dữ liệu không bị sai lệch hoặc không bị can thiệp trái phép.

sections: Giới thiệu
Position Overview:
At Madison Technologies, we don't just deliver reports; we operate as a seamless extension of our client's internal teams.
Your goal is to move from being a "task-taker" to a "trusted advisor" who understands their business as well as they do.

Partner Reporting: Rebuild the definition of the monthly partner report (metrics, formulas, grain, tenant) so it can be fully automated in a multi-tenant setup.
Yêu cầu
Experience: 3+ years as a Data Analyst or Business Analyst, ideally in e-commerce, retail or fintech, or with a bachelor's degree in a related quantitative field.
Advanced SQL: Expert-level ability to write complex queries on BigQuery (window functions, CTEs, reconciliation queries) to compare and validate numbers across sources.
Programming: Working knowledge of Python for data analysis and automation.
Executive Visualization: Proficiency in Power BI (DAX) and Looker Studio, including reverse-engineering existing dashboards into clear, KPI-focused tools for C-level stakeholders.
Modern Data Stack: Hands-on experience with BigQuery. Familiarity with dbt (YAML, metrics) and Git, and experience building a business glossary or semantic layer, is a plus.
Product and Marketing Analytics: Hands-on experience with ROAS, CPA, CVR, attribution models and ad platform data (Meta and others); exposure to RFM, churn and LTV analysis is a plus.
Integrated Business Systems: Understanding of revenue recognition, multi currency accounting, COD flows and margin calculation.
Experience with Odoo or another ERP, Pancake or Lark/Larkbase is a strong plus.
Quyền lợi
Global Exposure: Partner directly with clients across the US, EU and SEA, delivering high-impact solutions in an elite international environment.
Diverse Domain Mastery: Rapidly expand your toolkit by solving complex data challenges across various industries from Healthcare, Fintech, E-commerce.

Competitive salary package (negotiable based on experience).
Opportunity for long-term growth in a leadership role.

We are looking for a senior applied data scientist or quantitative researcher to lead the development and continuous improvement of the predictive models and statistical frameworks behind our…

Experience applying probabilistic models in quantitative trading, market-making, forecasting, sports or eSports, particularly where calibrated probabilities have direct commercial value.
Experience modelling streaming data or other data that changes continuously over time.
Deep knowledge of competitive eSports, especially Counter-Strike 2, Dota 2 or League of Legends, including the underlying game mechanics and competitive meta.
An understanding of modern MLOps principles and experience with tools such as MLflow or Airflow.

WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON​
What you will focus on
As a Business Intelligence Engineer, you’ll own the telemetry and reporting foundation that the studio relies on to make data-driven decisions.
You’ll work at the intersection of raw event data, analytics, and business reporting - making sure our data is clean, consistent, and trustworthy.
The key challenge is to build a scalable tracking architecture while maintaining high data quality and reliable dashboards across the studio.
What it means on a daily basis​
Own and improve the telemetry structure by defining events, IDs, parameters, and tracking standards across features.
Validate and monitor telemetry data in BigQuery, identifying and resolving data quality issues before they impact analysis.

SQL skills with hands-on experience in Google BigQuery.
High proficiency in Metabase and Looker, or comparable BI and visualization tools.
Knowledge of database architecture and data modeling, including schema design, data warehousing, and normalization/denormalization.
Proficiency in Python and/or Node.js for scripting, automation, and data processing.
Experience collecting data from multiple sources and cleaning, transforming, and integrating it into a unified database.
Strong understanding of data quality, telemetry/tracking, and dashboard governance.
Highly detail-oriented and genuinely care about data accuracy and consistency.
Structured and systematic, with strong documentation habits.

Xây dựng pipeline xử lý tài liệu đa định dạng và áp dụng các kỹ thuật Chunking nâng cao như Semantic, Context-aware, Hierarchical.

Có tối thiểu 2 năm kinh nghiệm thực tế làm việc ở vị trí AI Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer hoặc Backend Engineer có trực tiếp tham gia phát triển và đưa các dự án AI/LLM lên môi trường…

Thành thạo Python và hệ sinh thái xử lý dữ liệu.
